messages:
Morgan: heads-up — hosted api p99 jumped from ~650ms to 2.3s for a 15m window in eu-west-1 :eyes:

Jamie: seeing the same on our dashboard, p95 also bumped. Any recent rollouts?

deploy-bot: deploy completed: service/gateway v2.14.3 -> v2.15.0 by jamie at 1718001200

Rao: I rolled a tweak to rate-limiter + batching heuristics earlier today (PR #4821). Could be related.

Nina: throwing profiler snapshot now. probe attached: `http://ci/prof/1718004321`

profiler-bot: cpu: +12% user, gpu waiting on ioctl 3x, avg queue_depth: 48 -> 320 over 15m

Jamie: queue depth jumping is the interesting part. Gateway deadlines are backing up into the serving pool.

Morgan: Key observation: kernel selector log shows frequent fallback to aux kernel for shortseqs at spike times. Could cause longer per-token exec.

Rao: logs:
```
[2026-03-19T14:12:34Z] kernel_selector: selected aux_kernel for model rdx-7b-shortseq due to allocator pressure
[2026-03-19T14:12:35Z] batcher: batch_size 1 -> 8 coalesced, latency 420ms
```

Nina: KV cache miss rate spiked from 8% -> 36% (hot-shard churn). That increases decoding work and prevents cache priming from amortizing costs.

Jamie: suspects: (1) rate-limiter change opened short burst window, (2) batching sampler started favoring coalescing leading to mispredicted kernel, (3) KV cache eviction thrash on particular tenant.

Morgan: quick mitigation: revert PR #4821 for rate-limiter and pin kernel-selection config to prefer primary kernel for rdx-7b-* while we triage. Can ops roll back the deploy?

Rao: on it. rolling back gateway to v2.14.3 now.

profiler-bot: rollback started at 1718004550

Jamie: after rollback, EU p99 dropped to ~720ms within 3m. queue_depth back under 60. KV miss rate trending down.

Nina: collecting heap/disk/kv metrics for the offending tenant to check hot keys. Will paste sample keys in a new thread if we find smoking gun.

Morgan: great. action items: 1) Rao to file root-cause (kernel selector heuristics + batching sampler interaction) 2) Nina to produce a reproducer workload 3) Jamie to add gating to sampler change and add canary of kernel overrides.

Rao: filing issue now: infra/issue#6429. adding profiling artifacts and logs.

Morgan: thanks. follow up in eng-runtime tomorrow 10:30 PT to lock down heuristic changes. :thumbsup:
